Procedure Name.value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Phosphate Spot v1

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
Procedure Reference(s).value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (phosphate crystal) > Spot — compositions are reported per named phosphate grain ("Ph1" … "Ph4", with "stanf" or "merr"), each an average of numbered "single parallel measurement" spots (Table 2, p.10)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: PMG thick sections polished; same as olivine mapping preparation
Sample Preparation Method.value: PMG thick sections polished; same as olivine mapping preparation

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Mineral identity, from the μXRF survey — phosphates are located as "thin elongate inclusions in the kamacite-taenite metal matrix (e.g., μXRF map of Imilac at Fig. 1)", the identification resting "on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)" (p.4)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Mineral identity, from the μXRF survey

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited — Fe Kα intensity maps identify the mineral phases "based on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)", and the LA-ICP-MS areas correspond "to the locations indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4). The instrument is a Bruker M4 Tornado with a Rh-anode source at 50 kV and 150 μA, focused to "a 25 μm spot (measured for Mo Kα)" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

Laser Wavelength and Type.cell: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
Laser Wavelength and Type.value: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: 20 s spot ablation (plus 10 s washout); 25 cycles acquisition
Ablation Duration per Spot.value: 20 s spot ablation (plus 10 s washout); 25 cycles acquisition

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: MFC-1 0.270 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.250 l min⁻¹
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: MFC-1 0.270 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.250 l min⁻¹

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar make-up: 0.96 l min⁻¹; N₂ not added
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: Ar make-up: 0.96 l min⁻¹; N₂ not added

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.85 l min⁻¹
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.85 l min⁻¹

ICP Tuning.cell: Same instrument as olivine runs; tuned for normal plasma conditions
ICP Tuning.value: Same instrument as olivine runs; tuned for normal plasma conditions

Analysis Sequence.cell: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs at beginning → unknowns → repeated GRM at end
Analysis Sequence.value: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs at beginning → unknowns → repeated GRM at end

Target Species.cell: ²³Na, ²⁵Mg, ²⁷Al, ²⁹Si, ³¹P, ³⁹K, ⁴⁴Ca, ⁴⁵Sc, ⁴⁷Ti, ⁵¹V, ⁵³Cr, ⁵⁵Mn, ⁵⁷Fe, ⁵⁹Co, ⁶⁰Ni, ⁶³Cu, ⁶⁶Zn, ⁸⁵Rb, ⁸⁸Sr, ⁸⁹Y, ⁹⁰Zr, ⁹³Nb, ¹³³Cs, ¹³⁷Ba, ¹³⁹La–¹⁷⁵Lu (all REE), ¹⁸⁰Hf, ¹⁸¹Ta, ²⁰⁸Pb, ²³²Th, ²³⁸U (43 nuclides)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Trace element concentrations in the phosphate grains (µg/g), reported per named grain with the mineral identified as stanfieldite or merrillite (nominal) and each single parallel measurement listed (Table 2, p.10)

value.member: Trace element concentrations in the phosphate grains
reported per named grain with the mineral identified as stanfieldite or merrillite (nominal) and each single parallel measurement listed

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 5; duty cycle: 1.813 s; mass window 150% for ²³Na–⁴⁷Ti, 100% for all other nuclides

Background Count Time.cell: 8 gas blank scans; 11 ablation scans (25 cycles measurement: 15 s blank + 20 s ablation + 10 s washout)
Background Count Time.value: 8 gas blank scans; 11 ablation scans (25 cycles measurement: 15 s blank + 20 s ablation + 10 s washout)

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot analysis run per location (25 cycles: 15 s blank + 20 s ablation + 10 s washout); 3 replicates

Number of Replicates.cell: Multiple phosphate grains per meteorite; number varies by section
Number of Replicates.value: Multiple phosphate grains per meteorite; number varies by section

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Sum-of-major-oxide normalization to 100 wt% (Liu et al. 2008; Appendix C3)

Internal Standard Element.cell: No single IS; oxide sum normalization to 100 wt%

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Oxide sum normalization to 100 wt% corrects for ablation yield and matrix effects; external calibration with MPI-DING and USGS glass GRMs

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: Longerich et al. (1996) for LOD; uncertainty not formally described

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Anomalous time steps excluded (inclusions, cracks, heterogeneity); manual inspection
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Anomalous time steps excluded (inclusions, cracks, heterogeneity); manual inspection

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Anomalous time steps excluded during manual inspection
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Anomalous time steps excluded during manual inspection

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured before each spot analysis (8 scans); average background subtracted
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured before each spot analysis (8 scans); average background subtracted

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — same instrument settings; interference corrections as per Table C1

Interference Correction Method.cell: Same approach as mapping; oxide sum normalization partially corrects for matrix-dependent interferences

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: 10 s washout time after 20 s spot ablation (specified in acquisition protocol)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: 10 s washout time after 20 s spot ablation (specified in acquisition protocol)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: 100% oxide sum normalization to 100 wt% for phosphate minerals (Appendix C3)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — whole results are dropped, but on signal grounds: "where significant spikes in individual transient LA-ICP-MS signals were observed (e.g. Ca in CMS 04071 and Seymchan and Ni in Brahin and Seymchan), results were not included in Table 1" (p.6). By basis that belongs to Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach; no result-based selection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: all: Not combined — Table 2: 'All single parallel measurements are presented separately'

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: MPI-DING and USGS glass GRMs (measured at beginning and repeatedly at end of each session; multipoint calibration)

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs measured at beginning and repeatedly at end of each session
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs measured at beginning and repeatedly at end of each session

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: Same MPI-DING and USGS glasses measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment

value.member: Same MPI-DING and USGS glasses measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment

Additional Notes.cell: Phosphate phase identification used LA-ICP-MS data combined with EMPA and µXRF (Fig. D9); merrillite, stanfieldite, farringtonite distinguished by REE patterns; oxide sum normalization applied to phosphate (not olivine IS approach)
Additional Notes.value: Phosphate phase identification used LA-ICP-MS data combined with EMPA and µXRF (Fig. D9); merrillite, stanfieldite, farringtonite distinguished by REE patterns; oxide sum normalization applied to phosphate (not olivine IS approach)
